We are absolutely thrilled with this product. It is very easy to set up and use. It cleans even the most stubborn dishes. We did find rhat the water connection can lossen if you frequently move the hose. I'd suggest checking the connection every few days. All in all this is a fantastic buy.
if you live in an apartment check your size first.  I had to buy a cart for mine as it was 1/3 inch to tall.  works great and very nice.  I am single so only use about 1 or 2 times a week.
I love everything about my dishwasher.

What to say about the item that changed everything lol.... I am so glad I bought this. It's easy to use and works better than you would think a small dishwasher to work.... I cant imagine not having this in my life. I've been using it for like 6 months now and its great!!!
Broke after about 4 washed and their customer support is impossible to reach

It seems the controls stopped functioning. Not just the switches all buttons but the power button fail to function. I opened it up and looked for lose connections and found none. Couldn't find a way to fix it reliably for less than it cost to buy a new one. So I bought a new one with a protection plan. Not many other alternatives.

I have a neurological condition that progresses and it makes it very hard to wash glasses or almost any thing.  I moved to a new apartment a year ago and they had no dishwasher. The landlord gave me permission to get my own. seeing I broke two glasses and one plate the first month here and am disabled. I can do a day's worth of dishes but not big pots and pans.  It does a very nice job.

This dishwasher worked well and quietly but there was a problem from the beginning with a hose hookup in the back.  I thought it was just me but the part was unfit. When I tried to deal with DANBY customer service I was sent to a site I was going to have to pay for technical assistance. If you can buy a dishwasher like this for a similar price, get it from some other company.

Larsen Supply CO, INC. 09-1661NL... https://www.amazon.com/dp/B00404UGK6?ref=ppx_pop_mob_ap_share

Had to buy this adapter for the connector piece to fit my delta faucet. Once I got it running it’s great and I love it.

Ive only had this dishwasher for 2 months, and have discovered a major design flaw: if the spray arm is obstructed (like if something falls down into the basin by mistake, or the edge of a bowl dips below the tray slightly), the machine will continue to complete its cycle without stopping from the error. The cycle will continue, and your dishes will still be filthy at the end. Since then, I’ve run 3 cycles and each time, dishes do not come out clean. I’m going to run a cleaning cycle (with vinegar) and see if this helps. If not, I’ll be sending this back. A shame!

I had a problem with this thing not wanting to run a few months in. It had a flashing light on the bottom. I took this thing apart for nothing gained. I pulled out the rack and the disposal blade assembly. I got 2 reusable straws, stuck them together, stuck the end in the port that pushes water out, and I blew it out.

I put the disposal assembly back in, ran the dishwasher through a few false starts. Eventually, it started going through the full cycle again. I put the rack back in and haven't had problems since.

My recommendation, scrape and rinse off your dishes before putting them in there. It can handle heavy dirty loads, but eventually everyone has to pay the piper on that one.

We got this to replace a similar countertop dishwasher (different brand) that the electronics had failed.  The unit had several areas where it was dented in transit.  As it seems to be cosmetic damage only and getting it unpacked and up 2 flights of stairs was a project enough that we decided to accept them and not go through the process of a return since the likelihood of replacement coming with the same issues seemed high.

I was so excited to see receive the dishwasher but was very shocked when I discovered water droplets on the inside. Amazon provided a replacement for us. After waiting for a week, we received the new dishwasher. However, there was water inside this one too!

For as large as it is I would think you could fit more dishes inside. Make sure you invest in good dish soap and some finish otherwise the dishes come out wet. I wish there was a heat dry setting for sterilizing. The spinning sprayer inside is very weak. So far no leaks or draining issues.
LOVE IT!
Great Cleaning job. Rec. 5 star

I'm not going to Bull Ship you about this dishwasher. When I purchased this dishwasher I definitely had my finger on the return immediately trigger.  I've had it for a couple of weeks now and I'm happy to say my fingers off the trigger and the purchase turned out to be a game changer. This purchase turned a negative into a positive... its as simple as that. Now I look forward to doing dishes in my small cozy kitchen. My kitchen is a dish washing factory! Clean dishes here,  clean dishes today.  Clean dishes tomorrow... Happiness. 5 stars
This joker saved me.
Never buy ahead of time just installed to use lasted a week won’t flush water.

I have run it four full times now and oh my word, what are you waiting for?!  Over 6 years of hand washing dishes and now...I am in heaven!  It has perfectly cleaned every single thing I have put in it.  It's also surprisingly quiet, except for when it's draining.  Then...it scares the crap out of me.  Haha, every time.  Love this so much, you won't be disappointed!
All my fittings I put on were tight. It started to run and dumped water straight out the bottom of unit. DO NOT BUY THIS. I now have to have floor work done from water pouring out of bottom.

[[VIDEOID:52283a60a779506df5329917582d24c1]] This is my initial review. Only received it 2 days ago. Took till now to get enough dirty dishes to run it  :D  Set up was super easy and the adapter fit perfectly (how often does THAT happen right out of the box??) In the video you will hear almost NOTHING. It is so quiet while running, I'm astounded! I use a electric percolator coffee pot and IT was louder than the dishwasher running. Only slightly louder when emptying and has the splashing water into the sink sound. Did I say I was astounded with the quiet? LOL. So far I'm 1/3 through the wash cycle I chose and am watching it like a hawk to make sure there is no catastrophe. So far, no escaping water! I'll come back to review in a month or so to update this on how it goes after more than 1/2 of the first use  :D

After living in a studio apartment and hand washing dishes for 2 years, this little dishwasher is a game changer. It is super quiet while running. It was a little startling at first hearing the sound of the water draining out, but I'm getting used to it. The dishes are cleaner than I could ever get them by hand washing. I would recomend this to anyone in a small apartment and it might even work in a tiny house. This is the best purchase I've made in a while and this little dishwasher is worth every penny.
Love it works great

The two big things that I like is that it get dishes clean and with little sound. I got the Amazon rolling butcher block to allow me to move it. That just made it great and the dishes go into the washer without bending. Very happy. The bad is that you may have to do two loads if you have a large pasta pot. All is good though.

Use rinse aide and you will get the best results.

I am very impressed! It is bigger than I thought. It fits quite a lot and washes very well. Multiple settings. Very quiet and pretty. Super easy to set up. It doesn't fit on my counter so I keep it on a table near the sink, and simply connect it when ready to run a load.
I rated "easy to use"" as 3 stars only b/c it is hard to decipher the cycle icons.
I love how hot my dishes are when I open it,  But the timing confuses me I like to know how much time I have left before it is done so I had to buy me a timer..

The minute i used it I loved i t.  .Easy to use,  it has more room in it then you would think. Got my grimy dishes clean. It doesn't seem to get as extremely hot as the big ones which means it cleans plastic containers great. and doesn't melt them.  I would recommend this to anyone with limited space.

This counter top dishwasher is easy to set up and it's fairly quiet. It gets the dishes clean. I like it and would recommend it to anyone who hates hand washing dishes but has no room for a full sized dishwasher. Thumbs up for this product.
It gets the dishes so clean way more than I expected it to do I love it

This dishwasher worked fine for about a year.
One day it said E4, which meant it had a leak, after that the electronics never work right again.
I'm very disappointed, I really liked this dishwasher.☹️
I just received the dishwasher. The top of the dishwasher is dented on both side on the top.
The water lines loosened up because I was moving them a lot after each use to tuck them away. I used a plastic tie to to keep the lines from moving close to the machine connection. No more leaks.

I've used this dishwasher three times. So far I am very happy. I thought my expectations were maybe a bit to high but it has met them, no more, not a bit less. Product is exactly as pictured and described, from aesthetics to functionality. I totally hate hand washing dishes, and we are in an amazing little house built in the early 1930's with fascinating history, but installing a full size dishwasher would have required a remodel for the kitchen. This works perfectly for us, I highly recommend for a small family with limited space. It is super easy to install, simple to use, and is very quiet. Make sure to take measurements first, it fits under our cabinet without a half centimeter to spare. Whew!
First one leak for first run. Second one leak for the first run. same spot.

I don't make a lot of money, I am a single mother in a small apartment with my toddler and it took me a long time to work up the guts to spend the money on this Dish Washer but after having it for a month I am SO HAPPY with this purchase. So easy to use, very compact, and cleans my dishes perfectly.

This is huge dishwasher, but you will need to find something wide enough to put it on. Make sure to take proper measurements before setting it up. This machine is a powerful little bugger. It’s made my life so much easier! I went without a dishwasher for nearly a decade & now doing dishes is so much simpler. This is definitely a must have for small apartments with no dishwasher.

I've had this dishwasher for about 2 months and so far so good. It's bigger than I expected but it works very well. Two things to consider... The size, it's way bigger than a microwave. And since it connects to your faucet, you have to be sure you don't need to get around it or (obviously) use the sink. Just a little planning and it's all good. My apartment is an old building so it has its quirks. I really appreciate all the work it saves me. I would suggest buying a good quality dish detergent pod and be careful when you disconnect the faucet adapter because a lot of water will come out. Have towels ready :) would def reccomend

Easy to hook up to kitchen sink, a lot more room than one would think. I run it about twice a week. The dishes come out spotless & the heating element works well.
If you don't like to wash dishes by hand & don't like to see them in the sink, buy this unit to store dirty dishes until you need to run the cycle.
It works better than I had expected.

This was a countertop dishwasher. We wanted a dishwasher, but a standup one would be too big and unnecessary for our use. The Danby fits perfectly on our counter, even with cabinets above it. Its hoses are right next to our sink. It took a little while before we perfectly screwing the hoses in to avoid leaks, but once we did, that wasn't an issue. It's easy to use and the dishes come out amazingly clean.
[Added 12/26/20] My wife had this cookie pan that she could never get clean. She put it in the dishwasher and it was "cleaner than when I had bought it."

So why only 4-stars? When we first tog it, we got all excited and tried to attach it to our faucet. The adapter would not work. We contacted Danby's support and they said, "Oh, our adapters fit most faucets." So, we took it to a plumbing supply store. (Grover's, might as well plug them also). Turned out the adapter had a flattened lead thread. Unsuable. We contacted Danby and they immediately replaced it with one that works. (No charge; it was under warranty). We couldn't be more pleased with their response and the product.

I just use the light wash setting and it cleans good enough to please anyone.  It does indeed dry them with an internal heater.  10" plates are ideal.  11" plates will need to face the other way.  And will not hold as many.  But it holds quite a bit of dishes and large pots.  It's been a workhorse for me.  Good build quality.  It has only one sprayer on the bottom.  No sprayer on the top.  But I have packed it somewhat unfairly.  And I didn't get dishes that were only clean on one side.  All dishes get clean all over.  The drain might be a little loud.  But you can talk over it.  It doesn't run long except for the beginning drain cycle.  And you can tune it out at 12 feet.  The washing is quiet and almost soothing.  You can replace the hosing.  So you could get clever with mounting.  I have mine on a rolling kitchen cart/island that's counter high.  I did need rinse aid.  But I think I was just using too much dish soap.  And you will need to get used to that.  Also the soap door can get caught somewhat easily when it opens.  Not a big deal at all.  I jam the silverware basket full.  And it just does that.  All the soap is rinsed out and used  when the door partially opens.  But when washing odd sized dishes and loads you will need to make sure the door has enough room to partially open.  Despite this, it doesn't feel like a compromise dishwasher.  The rack is thoughtfully laid out.  So it isn't too much of a Jenga puzzle figuring out how to get everything in.  You can wash a

So glad i bought this hate doing dishes… It’s not noisy It is nice and quiet Really easy to use and you just hit the program button until it glows on the option u want the only down side where it goes in the counter its a bit bulkey but i can deal with that small sacrifice on space to make my life easier
Home kitchen...have a beautiful old log cabin. And old is the word. I garbage disposal or dishwasher can live without the disposal but the dishwasher....not a dish in the sink

This unit is small, but perfect for a couple it does an excellent job cleaning.
Uses very low amount of water.

So I installed it, ran it with a light load to make sure it will work. Disappointingly is started beeping and gave me an error code meaning a drain leak of some kind. I assumed it was a loose drain hose. So after tightnening it I continued to get the error until i titled it and dumped the water out. Then it would run until it would give me the same error code Flashing Glass shine mode. It did it twice more until I took the drain hose off the quick connect. I laid the drain hose in the sink and turned the dish washer sideways so i can see the back. I come back mid cycle and see there is a little bit of water puddling under the machine 1 little squirt at a time. So.. idk what's going on but I assume something is broken and it's leaking. I don't want to take it apart and void the warranty. looks like I'm returning it.
It's OK bot what I'm use to but good for a single person

When the box was opened, the top of the dishwasher was damaged.  Since the box was not caved in, I assumed the damage occurred prior to being crated for shipment.  While waiting trying to trace my return, I realized I wash more plastic carryout items than dishes, and decided not to reorder.

Everything gets cleaned really well, when sat on the Heavy Wash Cycle. Even 3 day old soup bowls! Also supprised to see how much can be put into one load, by a bit of stacking. Still clean.
Takes just over 2 hours to finish on Heavy. It also heats it's own water, so the hot water doesn't need to be on! That nice! And still clean....
After a couple of months, I'm more than happy with it. Good luck.
I had it one year and 6 weeks.  6 weeks long enough that the drain pump failed. Of course it fails on Thanksgiving day. Buyer beware.

I measured my clearance under my cabinets so it would not fit in my counter tops. Find a great rolling cart which helps with storage. That is the only problem I have with it. It's not really loud. Was easy to hook up and came with the parts I needed to use it right out of the box.

Very good machine low noise and washes my dirty dishes clean. I used the liquid Cascade & Rinse Agent. I am very very impressed. And I sat it on top of a counter height refrigerator to have more room on my counters. Love Love Love.
So nice to have an easy way to wash dishes in a tiny apartment!

I love my dishwasher it fits way more then i expected it gets everything mostly cleaned i like how it heats the water itself. Its quiet you need to make sure there is nothing in that sink when its draining because it comes out fast and splashes if there is too much in that sink. But well worth it if you want a dishwasher but have no where to put it.

Our rental didn't include a dish washer and we didn't want to have to try and buy and install a full-size one so we got this. I had forgotten the convenience and effectiveness a dishwasher brings to the table. It hooks in easily, I would recommend double checking the connections before running it to prevent any leakage. Instructions say not to use dishwasher packs and to use dishwasher liquid cleaner, we've been using the liquid Cascade Platinum and haven't had an issue. If dishes are super dirty they sometimes need to be ran twice but it always cleans them. Highly recommend.
It does a good job of getting the dishes clean and dry.
Sometimes it doesn't rinse as well but over all a great little dishwasher.  Especially since it heats water inside the machine.

Product works excellently , ive been using this dishwasher in my apartment for about 6 months now and it's a huge time saver for dishes.  Although it isnt a full size I can't say I haven't put pots and pans and everything else in it and it handles it without an issue ! Love this dishwasher !
Fits right on the counter. This makes my day so much more easier.
This little dishwasher works so well and was quiet. It was very easy to use and set up
Got this for my mom as a Christmas gift and she loves it!!!
Perfect if you've got a small kitchen like me. Makes life so much easier to not worry about handwashing dishes. We have to run it once every few days for a family of 2.

I live in a rental and cannot install a permanent dishwasher, there is limited room for a full size portable one. I researched for weeks and settled on this one. Wow! Am I impressed. It's super easy to use and runs very quiet.  The only noise you really here is when the pump goes off. The pumps kind of loud but only for a couple of minutes till its done emptying. I cook and bake alot and this dish washer can handle what ever i throw at it. It can fit more then you think with some creative loading.  The only time i've had a problem with unclean dishes us when I've over loaded it. I use liquid dishwasher detergent and have no issues. One thing i do recommend is not to use to much detergent as it will leave spots ,less is more.  The filter in the bottom is removable and very easy to clean. This dishwasher fits perfectly under my cabinet.  I wanted it further away from the sink at the end if my counter so hubby went to the hardware store bought four clamps, the right size hoses and extended the lines, works beautifully. Bought a giant command hook and attached it to the side of the dishwasher,  just roll up the hose and store there when not in use. All in all I'm very pleased with my purchase and would definitely buy again.

I have a tiny apartment (See pic) but needed a dishwasher to save my back and my chapped hands after all this lockdown cooking.

It has a giant capacity for a countertop model. As you can see, it's larger than the freezer on my fridge!

So far it is amazingly quiet. All I hear is water whooshing, no motor noise at all. **Edit to add, the beeps at the end of the cycle are a bit loud. Probably intentionally, but I don't run it late at night due to this**

It was easy to set up, not as heavy as UPS made it sound, and even though it takes up half my counter space, I think it was worth it.

Keep in mind this is day 1. I will update if any problems arise.

The only drawback so far is that it has the kind of 90 degree bend, 3 prong plugin that means generally only one appliance can fit per outlet. My refrigerator has the same kind, so I had to resort to a power strip.

I am a college student, I love this dishwasher.  I use it about once a day or so.  I load it and run it.  Now the area where it states you put your cups, that is bull.  Cups do not fit on the little shelf.  The only thing I found that will work there is a 4oz mason jar or some spatula's.  I just removed the inserts for the cups and don't use them.  My coffee cups go on the bottom.  When you get it, you will learn where what goes.  I would recommend it.  Great item for the price, would recommend to any college student.

This is my second counter-top dishwasher and I love it. Works well. Dishes shine and are squeaky clean. The only thng is don't buy the connector package they try to sell you. It's included in the dishwasher package.

This thing stopped working halfway through THE FIRST WASH CYCLE.

This thing was the best thing my husband got our house. Fits under our top cabinets by our sink. I have big square plated from Walmart and they fit. I'll trade a bit of countertop for the freedom of not banging my head on the over sink cabinets any day.
This little dishwasher has saved my life! It’s easy to use, it fits a good amount of dishes at a time, and it works! I’m so, SO pleased with my little dishwasher!

Exceptional

[[VIDEOID:da09e9ec933373b27f3d2f13ec93364e]] As soon as I turned it on it started pouring water out the front, my whole kitchen flooded! It is bigger than it looks on the outside, but still not a lot of space inside.

Took me a little while to understand how it works. I can’t seem to fit my dishes like the pictures I have seen, so it’s not really true to how much or what you can put in it. It’s not very loud at all, and it does clean dishes. It doesn’t dry, so we do have to dry them by hand. Despite the flaws, I would still recommend this product. This product was easy to set up and holds a lot of dishes for the size.  We have had a very positive experience using this dishwasher.  Recommend for those who need a dishwasher for a small kitchen space. To save counter space, we put it on a cart and just wheel it over when ready to load and run.
the darn thing started leaking on the first use. hopefully amazon will let me return it
Great product.  Installed on a wire shelf right next to the washing machine.  Works great.  Very  quite.  Great product, just the right size for our RV
I have larger plates (11.5”) they fit but you have to get a little creative. Overall it works great and I don’t have to wash dishes anymore!

It is a lot bigger than I thought it would be and too big for the dresser where I was going to place it. I put it on the counter next to the kitchen sink and it is perfect. I went ahead and bought the big box of Finish Detergent and Finish Rinse Aid at Walmart while waiting on this to arrive so it looks like I am set now for a life of bliss.

I like it just it just came wet and some

It's what you'd expect. Takes up some room, and makes noise, but nothing unbearable. Don't keep it running in your room when you're trying to sleep, and you'll be fine.

Purchased this and have had it set up for overa week now. Fanastic machine so far. We live off grid so best feature is the water saving low usage. Uses only a few gallon on normal and gets dishs nice and clean. We have not had a dishwasher for last 5 yrs so this is great. Super easy to install, came with everything needed for standard hookup.
Unit came with a small dent in front right corner that doesnt allow the door to shut properly. Still seems to work alright but disappointing

this is my 2nd DW like this, ONLY thing i dont like is the lack of a display timer (my 1st 1 had a timer display)
i dont like to run the heat dry (waste of electricity) so i have to use a kitchen timer, to know ehn to turn this off and open the door, they dry just fine with no spots like this

The dishwasher was wet with water stains all over the walls upon arrival. The quality of the wash is average as expected, it couldn't clean off dirty dishes well and leaves stains here and there. It did wash off oil quite well.
Great little item, easy to use and very affordable.
Had a little trouble hooking it to my faucet. It leaked everywhere. Had a plumber do it up right. It's been worth it though.
Product arrived damaged
Loving this machine so far!

I love this dishwasher! It’s great for small spaces, easy to hook up, and makes life so much easier. The noise isn’t bad either. I can still watch TV without having to turn the volume up. I’m very impressed with how much you can fit in it as well. Great buy!

Literally the best if you live in a rental & small apartment. You can definitely wash smaller pots & pants in this. So roomy. Not loud the only noise you ever really hear is the water being pumped into & out of. I’m obsessed!! Best purchase ever. Does not leak BUT make sure you use the provided washers with it! Comes with all the parts you need. Super super easy to put on & take off of your faucet! I love it. Totally worth it. Don’t let the negative reviews change your mind.

It works great for my family of 3. I tend to use the glass or quick setting because it would be done in less than 45 minutes. I rarely have to rewash anything. I do have to dry them off sometimes. It was easy to install  I did it by myself it only took about 20 minutes. I am only 5” 2 any I was able to lift it and hook it up so it is pretty light.
Much improved from my first one. Very quiet and easy to use. I like this design compared to the last one 12 years ago
Works well. No prewash before loading necessary!
washes great put casserole dish in without rinsing and came out clean what more do you need to say
It works and fits on counter
Thing doesn't work properly unless you tip the front of it upwards like an air conditioner. Also leaks out of it's frame. Junk.
We love this little dish washer, fits fine in the older home and goes a great job for 2 people.

It's the right size on the outside, but it could be bigger on the inside. The outgoing water hose is a bit difficult to connect. But once it is connected, the machine runs beautifully. Love the "noise" level since it's very quiet!  No problems so far and Danby service is excellent.

The dishwasher works excellent, ultra quiet operation, Does great job cleaning contents even with out pre rinsing glass or dish before putting in unit. I love this machine, i definitely recommend if your a tired parent or someone thats busy. Its helped improve my life.

I AM INCREDIBLY FRUSTRATED!!!! I need packaging along with a refund to return this useless product.
liked all

I really debated back and forth for a long time.  It seemed so frivolous!  Really, it's just me and I should be able to do the dishes for one person.  But I hate doing the dishes.  Don't know why.  Have to really talk to myself to be grateful to have the food to eat that dirties up the dishes in the first place.  But that hasn't helped.  I put it off until every thing in the house is dirty and THEN I wash the dishes and it takes forever.  SO! I bought the little dishwasher and hooked it up in my kitchen.  It takes up some space, but all the dishes go right in as soon as I'm done with them and when its full I turn it on and let it work.  I love this thing! I was skeptical at first wondering if this would be big enough to handle all my dishes (some needing heavy duty attention) or whether or not it was just a strong as a normal dishwasher. 3 days in after my purchase and I am very impressed with this machine!
So, I under estimated the size of this thing. It’s a lot bigger than I expected, I just barely had enough room to put it on my counter next to my kitchen sink like I envisioned where it would go, I had to modify my kitchen cabinet that sits above where the dishwasher is placed by cutting about a half inch off the bottom of the cabinet and now the dishwasher slides in place perfectly like it was meant to be there!

I’ve been washing my dishes by hand for almost 10 years now, I forgot how convenient it was to not have to scrub and soak your dishes and dry them off as I’ve been doing. I just load them in as is no matter how stuck on the mess and it handle it like childsplay. My dishes come out looking brand new! I can’t express how much this thing is helping me out by cleaning everything with such ease. It’s sooo quiet when running and the installation was a breeze, no tools needed!!! Huge bonus for that!

If you’re on the fence, I promise you, you won’t regret! I mean it can fit my largest pots and pans and clean them like it wasn’t dirty in the first place.
Has been a true work horse in our house.  The noise is well worth not having to do dishes be hand for my large family, and after a while the noise is not even noticeable.

I loveeeee it! We have a very crowded small house. It was easy to install. I did have to replace my sink faucet but it needed replaced anyway. We had the all in one hose sink and the hose was many years old and missing the outer pressure containment webbing. So after a few washes the hose bubbled and blew. Anyway. This dishwasher can get some of the dirtiest things clean and can fit a lot for being a countertop model. We had dishes piled up from Aug 2020. Plenty of stuck on yuck and it cleaned them all. It's quiet until the water drains but not any more than hearing a washing machine.

I absolutely love this dishwasher!!! It is a little tight for my dinner plates but it does meet my expectations with flying colors!!! It has cleaned everything that I have put in it and it is very quiet. It certainly beats handwashing everything every day!!! I have told everyone with limited space about it. I will definitely buy again when we wear this one out.

I had the washer sitting around for about a week or two before I was capable of using it. All because I thought installation was difficult. It's actually a simply attachment to your faucet that still allows you access to your water supply while the dishwasher runs. I have a complicated pull out faucet in my kitchen so I thought it wouldn't work. Nope! Attached the thingie and done.

Unless I angle the wares incorrectly or the stain has "set in", my dishes are always sparkling at the end of the cycle!
I was afraid of leaving the water turned on until I realize that the valve functions much like the controls on the faucet itself.

For people without the space or funds or qualms to install a dishwasher into your cabinets, this is the one for you!
